context.p: You can format shapes to change their appearance and make the diagram easier to read.

step.cmd: On the canvas, select the shape that you want to format.
In the right panel, click the Style tab.
If required, change the shape's fill color, line color, or line style.
If required, click the Text tab to change the font, text size, alignment, or text color.
If required, click the Arrange tab to change the shape's position, size, or rotation.
Repeat steps 1-5 for other shapes as needed.

result.p: The changes appear on the shape as you make them.
